google_reviews.text: The product and support you get at the store is 5 star, unfortunately the delivery service (via Zajel courier) is 1 star. they should partner with a professional courier services company for a better customer experience

google_reviews.author: Sandra
google_reviews.text: I’m very disappointed with my experience at this mattress store. They advertise a mattress with a cloud design (Teeny) both on their website and in their physical store at IKEA Festival City Mall, but after waiting three weeks for delivery, they brought a plain mattress with no design at all. When I contacted customer service, I was told that this was a new design without any prints — which is completely misleading, as it doesn’t match what they are still showing online or in-store. The staff were also quite rude and didn’t apologize or offer any solution until I specifically asked for a refund. This is false advertising and poor customer service. I wouldn’t recommend this store unless they correct their misleading product information and improve how they handle customer complaints.

products.description:
The firm, anatomically supportive "PRO Sport" mattress is Askona’s first model designed specifically for athletes and individuals with an active lifestyle. It promotes faster muscle recovery, reduces strain on the spine, and improves sleep quality, thereby helping to enhance athletic performance and overall well-being.
 This six-layer mattress combines enhanced ventilation, a "PRO Sport" tempered steel spring system, and a layer of adaptive foam. Thanks to this design, the model facilitates rapid muscle recovery, relieves spinal pressure, and improves sleep quality, helping to boost athletic performance and general well-being.
 Who is it for?
- Professional athletes.
-  People who exercise regularly or lead an active lifestyle.
-  Those who experience high levels of physical exertion during the day.
-  Those dealing with muscle tension who need high-quality recovery.
-  People prone to overheating while sleeping.
-  Those sensitive to pressure points in the shoulder and lower back areas.
 Mattress composition:
- Thermoregulating knit fabric, quilted with synthetic padding and high-resilience foam.
-  Adaptive foam.
-  Cotton felt.
-  Unique "PRO Sport" tempered steel spring unit.
-  Cotton felt.
-  High-durability adaptive foam.
 Advantages:
- The mattress's top layer, made of soft knit fabric, facilitates rapid moisture wicking. This is particularly important after workouts, when the body actively generates heat and moisture; the material helps quickly restore a comfortable sleeping microclimate and significantly reduces the sensation of overheating.
-  The vibrant 3D mesh on the side panel improves ventilation within the mattress's internal layers, ensuring continuous airflow. This maintains a stable temperature balance, reduces the risk of overheating, and accelerates moisture wicking, allowing the body to relax more quickly.
- Adaptive foam enhances airflow between mattress layers, provides soft cushioning, and reduces pressure points. It helps the body find a comfortable position during sleep and rest—essential for effective recovery after strenuous physical activity.
- Cotton felt helps distribute weight evenly, insulates the spring unit, and helps the mattress retain its original shape.
- The PRO Sport tempered steel spring unit is a firm spring system that features a metal perimeter frame at the top and bottom to reinforce the edges and ensure the stability of the sleeping surface. The reinforced structure helps distribute pressure evenly, support the body, and allow the mattress to quickly regain its shape after use. This is especially important after intense workouts, when muscles need to relax and the body requires solid support.
- Reinforced encasement maintains edge-to-edge firmness and minimizes perimeter deformation, thereby extending the mattress's lifespan.
-  The dark mattress design, featuring contrasting green mesh on the side panel, creates a stylish accent and highlights the model's premium, high-tech character. Helps create the right conditions for full recovery after workouts and a physically active day.
-  The above-average mattress height makes sitting down more comfortable and makes getting up easier.
-  The 2-in-1 hybrid design provides cushioning, relieves pressure, and supports the spine, regardless of sleeping position.
-  Adapts to your body position without a long "break-in" period, offering comfort from the very first moments of rest.
-  Designed to withstand regular use and maintain its properties under active conditions.
Important to know:
- Height: 23 cm
- Firmness: Firm
- Warranty: 30 years when purchasing a mattress protector
- Weight capacity: Over 140 kg
 Bed linen for your bedroom is available here.
 Tips for dealing with a new mattress:
 New mattresses may have a temporary manufacturing smell when unpacked. It is not harmful or toxic and will fade over time. Follow these steps to reduce the odor:
- Ventilate the mattress in a spacious room for at least a week.
- Vacuum cleaning can speed up the elimination of the smell.
- Remove bed linen from the mattress during the daytime.
 Please note:
- The manufacturer reserves the right to alter the stitch pattern of the mattress cover without prior notice.
- The height of the mattress may vary within a tolerance of ±1.5 cm.
- This mattress can be exchanged within 15 working days only when purchased with a mattress protector. For more details, please check our Return and Exchange Policy.
 The image is a sample. The actual appearance may differ from what is shown in the image while still maintaining all declared technical characteristics.

products.description:
Askona Basic Mattresses is a collection of basic mattresses at affordable prices for young active families who have purchased and furnished a new apartment, are doing renovations, are moving to another city or district, or are looking for a reliable and affordable mattress for their child's healthy sleep.
 The Basic Optima Hard mattress is a versatile and reliable model that suits everyone who values comfort and cares about their own health and the health of their loved ones.
 The mattress is made of a 5-zone spring block that individually supports each part of the body: head, shoulders, back, hips, and feet, relieving the load from the spine and tension from muscles and joints.
 The double-sided construction of the mattress provides different firmness levels on both sides. One side is made of natural coconut fiber, which gives it firmness. The other side combines coconut fiber with a layer of soft Orto Foam Air, which allows for comfortable sleep positions. 
 Advantages of the Optima Hard mattress:
- Withstands heavy loads
- Comfortable body support (550 springs per sleeping place)
- Moisture-resistant, non-toxic material
- Two firmness levels to choose from: medium firm and firm

- Antibacterial properties

reviews.author: Liana
reviews.text: I spent a long time choosing a mattress. I finally settled on the Classic Duo Diamond 160/200 from Askona, with two different firmness levels (medium/semi-firm). The mattress is well-made, odor-free, and of very high quality. It's a fantastic sleeper! My husband and I are very picky sleepers, but this mattress lived up to all our expectations, including its features and the price! When one of us changes position or gets up, it doesn't affect the other person in any way. No creaking or noise. Sleeping on this mattress is a pleasure! Buy it, don't hesitate! If I had to buy another one, I would buy this mattress 100 times over! Thank you to the manufacturer for a quality product!

products.description:
Classic Duo Hard Soft is a versatile mattress offering two firmness options: soft and firm. Its balanced filling makes it suitable for those who haven’t yet decided on their preferred level of firmness.
 The Classic mattress line combines modern technologies with classic materials to suit everyone's needs, leaving you to choose your preferred firmness.
 Advantages of the Classic Duo Hard Soft mattress:
-  
 The reinforced "HourGlass" spring system, with 7 support zones, evenly distributes the weight across the mattress and provides anatomical support to each area of the body.
-  
 A double layer of anatomical foam on one side enhances comfort and improves the mattress’s ability to conform to the body's natural shape.
-  
 The soft knitwear cover, quilted with synthetic padding, promotes a balanced sleep environment, helping to relieve fatigue and relax muscles before sleep.
-  
 The reinforced perimeter, made from environmentally friendly Rebond material, protects the mattress from deformation and helps maintain its anatomical properties throughout its lifespan.
 Mattress composition:
- Soft knitwear cover quilted with synthetic padding
- Double layer of anatomical foam
- Coconut fiber
- Felt
- 7-zone spring block
- Unique "HourGlass" spring system
- Reinforced perimeter
Important to know:
- Height: 24 cm
- Firmness: Firm/Soft
- Warranty: 25 years when purchasing a mattress protector
- Weight capacity: Over 140 kg
 Bed linen for your bedroom is available here.
 Tips for dealing with a new mattress:
 New mattresses may have a temporary manufacturing smell when unpacked. It is not harmful or toxic and will fade over time. Follow these steps to reduce the odor:
- Ventilate the mattress in a spacious room for at least a week.
- Vacuum cleaning can speed up the elimination of the smell.
- Remove bed linen from the mattress during the daytime.
 Please note:
- The manufacturer reserves the right to alter the stitch pattern of the mattress cover without prior notice.
- The height of the mattress may vary within a tolerance of ±1.5 cm.
- This mattress can be exchanged within 15 working days only when purchased with a mattress protector. For more details, please check our Return and Exchange Policy.

products.description:
Grether & Wells is a collection of luxurious American mattresses from a well-known premium brand, founded in 1859. These high-quality mattresses are used by internationally renowned hotel chains such as Hyatt, Radisson, Hilton, and others. Every third American millionaire sleeps on the Grether & Wells mattress. Famous movie stars include them in their rider.
 The secret of Grether & Wells' popularity is simple. Each mattress is a unique work of handmade art. Skilled craftsmen use patented technologies, ensuring exceptional quality and attention to detail: from the placement of the springs to the embroidery. There is no mass production, only an individual approach to each mattress.
 Advantages of the Grether & Wells Kelly mattress:
- Exclusively handmade using patented technologies
- Eco-friendly materials of the highest quality
- Turn-free technology that eliminates the need to turn the mattress over
- Quality control at every production stage
- Excellent Edge (reinforcement edge system)
 Composition of the Grether & Wells Kelly mattress:
- World Icons Belgian knitwear
- DUO CLOUD (non-woven bulk material)
- PLUSH Foam (anatomic foam)
- 7-zone Original Springs system (120 block, 1.8 thickness)
Important to know:
- Height: 25 cm
- Firmness: Medium firm
- Warranty: 30 years when purchasing a mattress protector
Bed linen for your bedroom is available here.
The Grether & Wells Kelly mattress is the epitome of elegance and indescribable comfort for your everyday reality.
 Tips for dealing with a new mattress:
 New mattresses may have a temporary manufacturing smell when unpacked. It is not harmful or toxic and will fade over time. Follow these steps to reduce the odor:
- Ventilate the mattress in a spacious room for at least a week.
- Vacuum cleaning can speed up the elimination of the smell.
- Remove bed linen from the mattress during the daytime.
 Please note:
- The manufacturer reserves the right to alter the stitch pattern of the mattress cover without prior notice.
- The height of the mattress may vary within a tolerance of ±1.5 cm.
- This mattress can be exchanged within 15 working days only when purchased with a mattress protector. For more details, please check our Return and Exchange Policy.

products.description:
Grether & Wells is a collection of American luxury mattresses from a well-known premium brand founded in 1859 by engineer and designer John Wells in California. Among the buyers of these high-quality mattresses are internationally renowned American hotel chains such as Hyatt, Radisson, Hilton, and others. Every third American millionaire sleeps on the Grether & Wells mattress. Famous movie stars include them in their rider.
 The secret of the Grether & Wells' popularity among the American elite is simple. Each mattress is a unique work of handmade art. During the manufacturing process, skilled craftsmen sequentially arrange springs, lay, fasten, and insulate layers of different materials. Then the mattress is compressed under high pressure and stitched through with extra-strong wool threads, which are secured with a decorative button. There is no automated machine production, only an individual approach to each mattress.
 The premium Grether & Wells collection combines traditional craftsmanship, the finest natural materials, and advanced modern technologies.
 The softest cotton, layered in soft mattress layers, easily allows air to pass through while remaining completely dry. Natural linen can maintain its shape even under prolonged pressure; it dissipates static electricity, dampens vibrations, and absorbs noise. Resilient latex conforms to the contours of the body, providing proper anatomical support.
 The revolutionary Comfort Foam with Airflow technology provides proper microcirculation of air and contributes to maximum comfort by quickly and effectively dissipating body heat. The Body Surround Edge Support system, located around the perimeter, strengthens the mattress structure and increases its usable surface area.
 The DualActive independent spring unit with two types of support—firm and soft—adjusts to the slightest movements of the body, ensuring superior support. The unique anatomical Minipocket spring system, characterized by its low height, provides point support for the spine and ideal comfort for restful sleep. The modern Adaptive technology ensures perfect adaptation to body contours using innovative shaped spikes on the springs. Each mattress has additional perimeter reinforcement, significantly reducing the feeling of "rolling off" the edge of the bed.
 Grether & Wells is a luxurious, prestigious collection for successful people who are accustomed to investing in what is truly valuable - their own health and premium-class comfort.
 The Grether & Wells REGAL mattress is a luxury representative of the extra-firm class of American elite mattresses. It has no weight restrictions, withstands regular intensive loads, and has a sufficiently firm surface for effective support of injured or damaged vertebrae.
 The Grether & Wells REGAL Mattress is based on:
- The softest cotton lies in the soft layers of the mattress. It allows air to easily pass through while remaining completely dry. Natural flax retains its shape even under prolonged loads, removes the accumulation of static electricity, and absorbs vibrations and noise. 
-  The revolutionary Comfort Foam with Airflow technology. It ensures proper air microcirculation and promotes maximum comfort by quickly and effectively dissipating body heat. The Body Surround Edge Support system, located around the perimeter, strengthens the mattress structure and increases its usable surface. 
-  Anatomical spring block Soft Touch 5 zones with a height of 150 mm (550 springs per bed). It is an anatomically independent spring system consisting of classically shaped springs, each of which is placed in a fabric bag. Each spring has two additional coils at the top and bottom for gentle support. The spring is compressed to the level of a classic spring and is constantly under high pressure. The mattress has additional perimeter reinforcement, which significantly reduces the feeling of “slipping” at the edge of the bed.

products.description:
Grether & Wells is a collection of luxurious American mattresses from a well-known premium brand, founded in 1859. These high-quality mattresses are used by internationally renowned hotel chains such as Hyatt, Radisson, Hilton, and others. Every third American millionaire sleeps on the Grether & Wells mattress. Famous movie stars include them in their rider.
 The secret of Grether & Wells' popularity is simple. Each mattress is a unique work of handmade art. Skilled craftsmen use patented technologies, ensuring exceptional quality and attention to detail: from the placement of the springs to the embroidery. There is no mass production, only an individual approach to each mattress.
 The Grether & Wells Genesis mattress is a standout option from the collection of American luxury mattresses, offering a medium soft firmness level. It combines two important parameters—the highest quality of premium mattresses and necessary features for a transformable base. The mattress is equipped with MiniPocket Adaptive technology, a unique block of independent springs that synchronizes with the base's movements, ensuring optimal and targeted support for the sleeper's spine throughout their entire night's rest.
 The Grether & Wells Genesis mattress is based on:
- The softest cotton layers of the mattress. They allow air to circulate, remaining completely dry. Natural flax retains its shape even under prolonged loads. It absorbs vibrations and noise and prevents static electricity buildup. Elastic latex provides correct anatomical support for every curve of the body.
- The innovative Comfort Foam with Airflow technology. It ensures proper air microcirculation, quickly dissipating body heat and promoting maximum comfort. The Body Surround Edge Support system, located around the perimeter, strengthens the mattress structure and increases its usable surface.
- MiniPocket Adaptive Technology, a block of independent springs with a height of 55 mm (2000 springs per sleeping place). It is a unique "pocket" system, known for its low height and improved ergonomic properties. This technology provides exceptional point elasticity for perfect comfort. Each mattress has additional perimeter reinforcement, which significantly reduces the feeling of "slipping" at the edge of the bed.
 Advantages of the Genesis mattress:
- Exclusively handmade using patented technologies
- Eco-friendly materials of the highest quality
- Turn-free technology that eliminates the need to turn the mattress over
- Quality control at every production stage
- Perfectly fits ergomotion bed bases 
Important to know:
- Height: 25 cm
- Firmness: Medium
- Warranty: 30 years when purchasing a mattress protector
- Weight capacity: Over 140 kg

products.description:
Please note: Delivery for this mattress will take place no earlier than 10 days after order confirmation. Contact a manager to confirm your exact delivery day.
 Askona Original Pro mattresses are a collection of innovative mattresses at affordable prices for ambitious people who have made the latest technologies an integral part of their lives.
 Askona Original Pro mattresses are equipped with 7-zone hourglass carbon springs. This is a unique patented formula of the springs that allows the mattress to withstand intense loads. Each spring is shaped like an hourglass, enabling it to achieve several levels of elasticity for each anatomical zone: the 3 springs in one effect. This technology allows you to relieve stress from the spine and tension from muscles and joints and creates ideal conditions for comfortable sleep and relaxation.
 The Original Pro 5.0 mattress is a comfortable and reliable model that suits everyone who appreciates comfort and affordable technologies for maximum sleeping comfort.
 Advantages of the Original Pro 5.0 mattress:
- Maintains the spine in a physiologically correct position
- Withstands 5 times more load
- Ten-fold elasticity for enhanced comfort
- Moisture-resistant, non-toxic material
- Good air circulation
- Equal firmness on both sides – medium
 Mattress composition:
- Belgian knit fabric with viscose, quilted on high-elastic foam
- Memory Foam with shape memory
- Cotton felt
- 7-zone Hour Glass Carbon spring block
- Artificial latex
- Perimeter reinforcement with environmentally friendly rebond polyurethane foam, which has high density
- The side of the mattress made of breathable 3D mesh
 Important to know:
- Height: 29 cm
- Firmness: Medium
- Warranty: 25 years when purchasing a mattress protector
- Weight capacity: Over 140 kg
 Bed linen for your bedroom is available here.
 Askona mattresses are the foundation of what matters to you.
 Tips for dealing with a new mattress:
 New mattresses may have a temporary manufacturing smell when unpacked. It is not harmful or toxic and will fade over time. Follow these steps to reduce the odor:
- Ventilate the mattress in a spacious room for at least a week.
- Vacuum cleaning can speed up the elimination of the smell.
- Remove bed linen from the mattress during the daytime.
 Please note:
- The manufacturer reserves the right to alter the stitch pattern of the mattress cover without prior notice.
- The height of the mattress may vary within a tolerance of ±2.5 cm.
- This mattress can be exchanged within 15 working days only when purchased with a mattress protector. For more details, please check our Return and Exchange Policy.
 The image is a sample. The actual appearance may differ from what is shown in the image while still maintaining all declared technical characteristics.

products.description:
Please note: Delivery for this mattress will take place no earlier than 10 days after order confirmation. Contact a manager to confirm your exact delivery day.
 The Teeny mattress is an ideal choice for children aged 7 years and older. When mental and physical stress at school increases and daytime sleep disappears, a child needs to sleep comfortably. The Teeny mattress will help them with this. 
 Advantages of the Teeny mattress:
- Proper support for the entire body during sleep to relieve physical fatigue
- Provides the correct formation of the child’s posture
- Possible to produce a non-standard size (contact the manager for advice)
- Hypoallergenic, abrasion-resistant materials
- Does not absorb excess odors
- Good air exchange
- Suitable for people with allergies and sensitive skin
 Mattress composition:
- Eco foam of high density
- A unique block of independent MiniPocket springs
- Natural linen
- Cover made of high-quality knitwear 
Important to know:
- Height: 15 cm
- Firmness: Medium
- Warranty: 3 years when purchasing a mattress protector
- Weight capacity: Up to 90 kg
 Bed linen for your bedroom is available here.
 The TEENY mattress: comfortable recovery—a healthy and intelligent child.
 It is possible to produce a non-standard size (contact the manager for advice).
 Tips for dealing with a new mattress:
 New mattresses may have a temporary manufacturing smell when unpacked. It is not harmful or toxic and will fade over time. Follow these steps to reduce the odor:
- Ventilate the mattress in a spacious room for at least a week.
- Vacuum cleaning can speed up the elimination of the smell.
- Remove bed linen from the mattress during the daytime.
 Please note:
- The manufacturer reserves the right to alter the stitch pattern of the mattress cover without prior notice.
- The height of the mattress may vary within a tolerance of ±1.5 cm.
- This mattress can be exchanged within 15 working days only when purchased with a mattress protector. For more details, please check our Return and Exchange Policy.
 The image is a sample. The actual appearance may differ from what is shown in the image while still maintaining all declared technical characteristics.

A true classic, combining pocket-sprung support with natural, luxurious resilience.

products.description: Plush mattress, suitable for side sleepers Made with cooling cover, Talalay latex, cooling coils, copper memory foam, Englander elite edge technology, and pocketed springs Standard and express delivery are available 10-year warranty. Cooling cover: Our Cooling Cover is made with chilling molecules that absorb heat, which creates a cooler surface. Once the heat source is cooled, the molecules revert to their natural state until they are heated again. This process reduces temperature fluctuations, resulting in a cool and comfortable sleep experience. Talalay latex: Built with both 100% Natural Talalay Latex, these comfort layers provide an elevated, uplifted feeling with the sensation of a gentle transition for pressure relief and contouring comfort—all infused with the healing and anti-inflammatory properties of Natural Talalay Latex. 3° Cooling coils: Our 3° Cooling Coils are tiny springs that allow heat and humidity to naturally escape the mattress for cool and comfortable sleep. Englander elite edge technology: Englander Edge Elite features our highest number of edge coils to eliminate that roll-off feeling. Our steel coil perimeter system gives you a consistent sleep surface edge-to-edge, and the doesn’t buckle when you sit on the side of the bed. 1130 Fabric-wrapped springs: This mattress is packed with 1,130 contouring, comfortable fabric-wrapped springs that offer world-class support and are proven 26% more durable than foam-encased mattresses. Our unique coils are made with tempered steel wire—once formed into their final shape, tempering freezes those molecules in place so that springs will remain strong to offer you comfortable sleep night after night. Copper Infused Memory: Copper Memory Foam creates a gentle transition for pressure relief and contouring comfort infused with the healing and anti-inflammatory properties of copper.

reviews.text: Excellent Mattress We went for a pillow top plush mattress due to recent back issues with our old mattress.
